name: Time clock
description: Time clock for employees: clock in and out with one tap, breaks, a legal working-day record (Spain, art. 34.9 ET) with a correction trail, and an optional workplace radius for personal devices.

require_location.label: Require location when clocking in from a personal device
require_location.description: The counter POS (shared device) is never asked for a location.

geofence_radius_m.label: Allowed radius (metres)
geofence_radius_m.description: How far from the workplace a personal device may clock in.

workplace_lat.label: Workplace latitude
workplace_lat.description: Leave empty until the workplace location is set.

workplace_lng.label: Workplace longitude
workplace_lng.description: Leave empty until the workplace location is set.

auto_close_after_hours.label: Flag open days for review after (hours)
auto_close_after_hours.description: A working day still open after this many hours is marked for review.

errors.attendance.clock_in_rejected: Could not clock in: you already have an open working day, or this device is outside the allowed radius.
errors.attendance.no_open_record: There is no open working day to clock out of.
errors.attendance.break_rejected: Could not start a break: there is no open working day or a break is already running.
errors.attendance.no_open_break: There is no running break to end.
errors.attendance.record_not_found: The working day could not be corrected: it does not exist, the clock-out is not after the clock-in, or reopening it would leave the person with two open days.
errors.attendance.settings_not_saved: The time clock settings could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

clock.title: Time clock
clock.locationRequired: Your location is checked when you clock in from this device.
clock.distance: You are {distance} m from the workplace.
clock.outsideRadius: You are {distance} m from the workplace, outside the allowed {radius} m. Move closer to clock in, or clock in at the counter.
clock.workplaceNotSet: The workplace location is not set yet, so this device cannot clock in. Ask a manager to set it in the time clock settings, or clock in at the counter.
clock.locationDenied: Location access is denied. Allow location for this app to clock in from this device, or clock in at the counter.
clock.reloadFailed: The screen could not be refreshed: {reason}

records.exportEmpty: There are no records for this filter: the file only has the header.
records.exportFailed: The CSV could not be exported. Try again.
records.loadFailed: The records could not be loaded.
records.usersUnavailable: The names of the team could not be loaded: people are shown by their id.
records.breaksUnavailable: The running breaks could not be loaded: the worked time of open days may include them.
records.reasonHelper: Required. It stays in the history of the day with your name.
records.invalidClockIn: Enter the clock-in date and time.
records.invalidCorrection: The clock-out must be after the clock-in.

records.saveFailed: The correction could not be saved. Try again.
records.historyEmpty: This working day has never been corrected.
records.historyFailed: The history could not be loaded.

settings.title: Time clock settings
settings.intro: Decide whether a personal device must be at the workplace to clock in. The counter POS (shared device) is never asked for a location.
settings.requireLocation: Require location when clocking in from a personal device
settings.accuracy: Position read with an accuracy of ±{accuracy} m. Do this from the workplace itself.
settings.workplaceMissing: Set the workplace location or nobody on a personal device will be able to clock in.
settings.autoCloseHelp: A working day still open after this many hours is marked for review so a manager can correct it.
settings.invalidLatitude: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90.
settings.invalidLongitude: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180.
settings.coordinatesIncomplete: Fill in both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
settings.invalidAutoClose: Enter a whole number of hours between 1 and 24.
settings.locationDenied: Location access is denied. Allow location in this browser to read the workplace position, or type the coordinates.
settings.readOnly: Only a manager or administrator can change these settings.

common.unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
common.locationUnavailable: Your position could not be determined. Move to an open area and try again.
common.locationTimeout: Getting your position took too long. Try again.
common.locationUnsupported: This device cannot share its location.
